description:
How to Make Money in Stocks by William J. O'Neil dismantles the fatal mistake retail investors make: buying a falling stock because it looks cheap.

In this comprehensive breakdown of "How to Make Money in Stocks" by William J. O'Neil, we dismantle traditional retail investing assumptions and explore the CAN SLIM methodology. You will learn why leading growth stocks break out to new highs rather than cheap lows, how institutional volume footprints reveal where smart money flows, and why cutting losses ruthlessly at 7 to 8 percent is the mathematical key to compounding capital.
